Messages.Author: suoli
Messages.Body:
1. My prey controls Undele and calls a referendum to move two minion
cards (A and B) from his ash heap to his hand. After the terms of the
referendum are declared I tap Erciyes Fragments to steal card B from
his ash heap. What happens next?
Does the referendum fail?
Does my prey get card A but not B?
Does my prey get card A from his ash heap and card B from Erciyes
Fragments?
If he does, what happens if I play card B from Erciyes Fragments
before the referendum is over?

2. Similar scenario but my prey only has 2 minion cards in his ash
heap and I tap Erciyes Fragments before reaching the referendum. Does
the action fail?

Undele
Clan: Ishtarri (group 5)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL FOR obf pre ser
Laibon magaji: Undele may call a referendum to move two minion cards
from your ash heap to your hand as a +1 stealth political action
(discard afterward).

Erciyes Fragments, The
Type: Master
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Tap this card to move a library card from your
prey's ash heap to this card, face down. You may look at that card at
any time. You may play the card from the Fragments as if playing it
from your hand (requirements and cost, if any, apply as normal). When
that card is burned, remove it from the game instead. Only 1 card can
be on this card at a time. Any vampire with a capacity above 4 can
steal the Fragments (and any card on it) for his or her controller as
a (D) action.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Sep 16, 4:20 pm, suoli <suoliruse...@gmail.com> wrote:
> 1. My prey controls Undele and calls a referendum to move two minion
> cards (A and B) from his ash heap to his hand. After the terms of the
> referendum are declared I tap Erciyes Fragments to steal card B from
> his ash heap. What happens next?

Assuming that was the only copy of B in the ash heap...

> Does the referendum fail?

Not automatically.

> Does my prey get card A but not B?

Yes, if the referendum passes.

> Does my prey get card A from his ash heap and card B from Erciyes
> Fragments?

No.

> If he does, what happens if I play card B from Erciyes Fragments
> before the referendum is over?
>
> 2. Similar scenario but my prey only has 2 minion cards in his ash
> heap and I tap Erciyes Fragments before reaching the referendum. Does
> the action fail?

When the time comes to set the terms, the referendum fizzles if the
terms cannot be set, yes.
